run: if ! command -v flutter &>/dev/null; then echo 'ERROR: Flutter SDK is not installed. Install Flutter 3.x to work on hub_android.'; exit 1; fi
if [ -z "${ANDROID_HOME:-}" ] && [ -z "${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-}" ]; then echo 'WARNING: ANDROID_HOME or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT not set. Set Android SDK path for Android builds.'; fi
